analysis:
Examined the selected-model recovery changes across the autopilot files. They are local residency/availability logic (A-018, T-059 area) and do not touch prompt data, keys, attestation, App Attest authorization or the cache.

Changes: (1) ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift:213 calls noteSelectedModelUnloaded(victim, by: command) after a successful victim unload, inside the existing ownership and cancellation checks. (2) ProviderLoop+AutopilotBusy.swift:22 adds selectedModelRecovery.attempt != nil to the .preload busy reason. This is conservative: it refuses new autopilot commands while recovery is in flight and does not widen access. (3) ProviderLoop+AutopilotControl.swift:76 caches config.backend.enabledModels into savedEnabledModels when the config loads. It does not alter consent, revision or control checks, and reads the same owner-controlled config path as before. (4) The new ProviderLoop+SelectedModelPlacementPolicy.swift adds adoptionReleaseTime and releaseAdoptionForSelectedModelRecovery. Release is gated on non-protected, valid adoption, no unexpired hold, all exclusion reasons being serving, a 600s delay, minimum dwell, and the per-model lease. Release only removes the model from autopilotAdoptedModelIDs, withdraws it from new requests, lets in-flight work finish, and republishes the snapshot and heartbeat. It is not a bypass of lease or hold, and it does not evict mid-request. (5) ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift:82 invokes checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue() in the periodic capacity refresh.

Remaining questions, none shown to be a regression: the definitions of noteSelectedModelUnloaded, checkSelectedModelRecoveryIfDue, selectedModelRecovery, isProtectedFromRecoveryEviction and savedEnabledModels are in files not supplied, and so are the coordinator's handling of withdrawn adoption and the local add-on hold socket interaction (TB-012). The next pass should check that recovery cannot override an add-on hold (autopilotHoldsModel) or load a model while addonHoldActive. It should also check that the savedEnabledModels trust source cannot be influenced by a local non-owner.
